title: Yeasty Ethiopian Almond Wrap
description: A fluffy, bouncy brunch wrap infused with toasted almonds and fragrant Ethiopian spices. Wraps are baked in parchment for a moist, papillote finish and are kosher-friendly for a wholesome start to your day.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a large bowl until mixed.
Whisk warm milk, egg and oil in a separate bowl, then pour over dry ingredients and stir until dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Fold in toasted almonds, berbere spice, cumin, honey and parsley, mixing until evenly distributed.
Cover the dough, let rise in a warm place for 60 minutes or until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into three equal portions, roll each into a flat rectangle.
Place a spoonful of almond mixture in the center of each rectangle, fold over and seal the edges to form a wrap.
Wrap each completed wrap in parchment paper, sealing the top with foil.
Bake the parchment-wrapped wraps at 200C for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, let rest for 5 minutes before unfolding.
Drizzle a little extra honey over each wrap and serve warm.
Enjoy a yeasty, almond-infused brunch treat that feels like a breakfast pastry and a savory snack all in one.
